title: Terms and Conditions
description: Terms governing the use of the MSAK Student Portal.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
paragraphs: By accessing or registering on the MSAK Student Portal, you agree to comply with these Terms and Conditions and the related MSAK policies. If you do not agree, do not use the portal.

sections.heading: 2. Membership and Registration
paragraphs: All registration information must be accurate, truthful and kept reasonably current. You are responsible for activity carried out through your account.
Registration does not automatically guarantee membership approval, a leadership appointment or publishing access. Access to portal features depends on the relevant MSAK review and permissions.

sections.heading: 3. Leadership Verification
paragraphs: All declared leadership positions are subject to verification and approval by the appropriate MSAK authority. A request remains pending until it has been reviewed.

sections.heading: 4. Announcements
paragraphs: Only verified leaders may publish announcements, and only to the audience of their approved role: their institution, their association, or the nation. See the Announcements Policy.

sections.heading: 5. Acceptable Use
paragraphs: Use the portal lawfully and respectfully. Do not attempt to access another person's account, interfere with portal security, submit misleading information or misuse member information.

sections.heading: 6. Account Security and Changes
paragraphs: Protect your login credentials and report suspected unauthorised access to MSAK. MSAK may update these terms as the portal and its policies develop. The version and last-updated date shown on this page identify the current text.
